mapper.insert: insert into post(id, user_id, title, content, type, is_anonymous) VALUES (null,#{userId},#{publishPostDTO.title},#{publishPostDTO.content},#{publishPostDTO.type},#{publishPostDTO.isAnonymous})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.type, p.is_anonymous, p.like_count, p.create_time, CASE WHEN p.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '匿名用户' ELSE COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) END AS authorName, CASE WHEN p.is_anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.avatar END AS authorAvatar, ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_reply cr WHERE cr.post_id = p.id AND cr.status = 1)) AS commentCount FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post WHERE id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM post WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
